title: Upholstered furniture brand expanding to Great Britain (London)
assumptions: A US upholstered furniture brand selling sofas in Great Britain through a UK company. The UK company and tax filings abstain (no quote on record) and are set aside; scored are Great Britain's product rules: GPSR 2005 traceability, the UK Timber Regulations and the furniture fire safety regulations (cigarette and match tests), each from gov.uk or legislation.gov.uk.

facts.quote: The producer must also allow for traceability by indicating on the product or its packaging, where reasonable to do so:
Operators must not place illegally harvested timber on the GB market and to avoid doing so must first apply a due diligence system,
no furniture to which this regulation applies shall include upholstery which does not pass the cigarette test in Part I of Schedule 4
any visible part of the cover shall pass the match test in Part I of Schedule 5 to these Regulations
